metadata_system.name: iCalendar / ICS Metadata
metadata_system.description: iCalendar Object Specification per RFC 5545. The format is composed of Components (VCALENDAR, VEVENT, VTODO, VJOURNAL, VFREEBUSY, VTIMEZONE, VALARM) containing Properties (UID, DTSTAMP, DTSTART, SUMMARY, etc.) optionally with Parameters (TZID, ROLE, CN, etc.) of typed Values.

attribute.name: VEVENT
attribute.description: Provide a grouping of component properties that describe an event.

attribute.name: VTODO
attribute.description: Provide a grouping of calendar properties that describe a to-do.

attribute.name: VJOURNAL
attribute.description: Provide a grouping of component properties that describe a journal entry.

attribute.name: VTIMEZONE
attribute.description: Provide a grouping of component properties that defines a time zone.

attribute.name: VALARM
attribute.description: Provide a grouping of component properties that define an alarm.

attribute.name: CALSCALE
attribute.description: This property defines the calendar scale used for the calendar information specified in the iCalendar object. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in an iCalendar object. The default value is "GREGORIAN".]

attribute.name: METHOD
attribute.description: This property defines the iCalendar object method associated with the calendar object. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in an iCalendar object.]

attribute.name: PRODID
attribute.description: This property specifies the identifier for the product that created the iCalendar object. [Conformance: The property MUST be specified once in an iCalendar object.]

attribute.name: VERSION
attribute.description: This property specifies the identifier corresponding to the highest version number or the minimum and maximum range of the iCalendar specification that is required in order to interpret the iCalendar object. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified once in an iCalendar object.]

attribute.name: ATTACH
attribute.description: This property provides the capability to associate a document object with a calendar component.

attribute.name: CATEGORIES
attribute.description: This property defines the categories for a calendar component. [Conformance: The property can be specified within "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar components.]

attribute.name: CLASS
attribute.description: This property defines the access classification for a calendar component. [Conformance: The property can be specified once in a "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar components.]

attribute.name: COMMENT
attribute.description: This property specifies non-processing information intended to provide a comment to the calendar user. [Conformance: This property can be specified multiple times in "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", and "VFREEBUSY" calendar components as well as in the "STANDARD" and "DAYLIGHT" sub-components.]

attribute.name: DESCRIPTION
attribute.description: This property provides a more complete description of the calendar component than that provided by the "SUMMARY" property.

attribute.name: GEO
attribute.description: [Conformance: This property can be specified in "VEVENT" or "VTODO" calendar components.]

attribute.name: LOCATION
attribute.description: This property defines the intended venue for the activity defined by a calendar component. [Conformance: This property can be specified in "VEVENT" or "VTODO" calendar component.]

attribute.name: PERCENT-COMPLETE
attribute.description: This property is used by an assignee or delegatee of a to-do to convey the percent completion of a to-do to the "Organizer". [Conformance: This property can be specified once in a "VTODO" calendar component.]

attribute.name: PRIORITY
attribute.description: This property defines the relative priority for a calendar component. [Conformance: This property can be specified in "VEVENT" and "VTODO" calendar components.]

attribute.name: RESOURCES
attribute.description: This property defines the equipment or resources anticipated for an activity specified by a calendar component. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in "VEVENT" or "VTODO" calendar component.]

attribute.name: STATUS
attribute.description: This property defines the overall status or confirmation for the calendar component. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar components.]

attribute.name: SUMMARY
attribute.description: This property defines a short summary or subject for the calendar component. [Conformance: The property can be specified in "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VALARM" calendar components.]

attribute.name: COMPLETED
attribute.description: This property defines the date and time that a to-do was actually completed. [Conformance: The property can be specified in a "VTODO" calendar component. The value MUST be specified as a date with UTC time.]

attribute.name: DTEND
attribute.description: This property specifies the date and time that a calendar component ends. [Conformance: This property can be specified in "VEVENT" or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components.]

attribute.name: DUE
attribute.description: This property defines the date and time that a to-do is expected to be completed. [Conformance: The property can be specified once in a "VTODO" calendar component.]

attribute.name: DTSTART
attribute.description: This property specifies when the calendar component begins. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components as well as in the]

attribute.name: DURATION
attribute.description: This property specifies a positive duration of time. [Conformance: This property can be specified in "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VALARM" calendar components.]

attribute.name: FREEBUSY
attribute.description: This property defines one or more free or busy time intervals. [Conformance: The property can be specified in a "VFREEBUSY" calendar component.]

attribute.name: TRANSP
attribute.description: This property defines whether or not an event is transparent to busy time searches. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in a "VEVENT" calendar component.]

attribute.name: TZID
attribute.description: This property specifies the text value that uniquely identifies the "VTIMEZONE" calendar component in the scope of an iCalendar object. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified in a "VTIMEZONE" calendar component.]

attribute.name: TZNAME
attribute.description: This property specifies the customary designation for a time zone description. [Conformance: This property can be specified in "STANDARD" and "DAYLIGHT" sub-components.]

attribute.name: TZOFFSETFROM
attribute.description: This property specifies the offset that is in use prior to this time zone observance. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified in "STANDARD" and "DAYLIGHT" sub-components.]

attribute.name: TZOFFSETTO
attribute.description: This property specifies the offset that is in use in this time zone observance. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified in "STANDARD" and "DAYLIGHT" sub-components.]

attribute.name: TZURL
attribute.description: This property provides a means for a "VTIMEZONE" component to point to a network location that can be used to retrieve an up- to-date version of itself. [Conformance: This property can be specified in a "VTIMEZONE" calendar component.]

attribute.name: ATTENDEE
attribute.description: This property defines an "Attendee" within a calendar component.

attribute.name: CONTACT
attribute.description: This property is used to represent contact information or alternately a reference to contact information associated with the calendar component. [Conformance: This property can be specified in a "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar component.]

attribute.name: ORGANIZER
attribute.description: This property defines the organizer for a calendar component.

attribute.name: RECURRENCE-ID
attribute.description: [Conformance: This property can be specified in an iCalendar object containing a recurring calendar component.]

attribute.name: RELATED-TO
attribute.description: This property is used to represent a relationship or reference between one calendar component and another. [Conformance: This property can be specified in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", and "VJOURNAL" calendar components.]

attribute.name: URL
attribute.description: This property defines a Uniform Resource Locator (URL) associated with the iCalendar object. [Conformance: This property can be specified once in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components.]

attribute.name: UID
attribute.description: This property defines the persistent, globally unique identifier for the calendar component. [Conformance: The property MUST be specified in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components.]

attribute.name: EXDATE
attribute.description: This property defines the list of DATE-TIME exceptions for recurring events, to-dos, journal entries, or time zone definitions.

attribute.name: RDATE
attribute.description: This property defines the list of DATE-TIME values for recurring events, to-dos, journal entries, or time zone definitions.

attribute.name: RRULE
attribute.description: This property defines a rule or repeating pattern for recurring events, to-dos, journal entries, or time zone definitions.

attribute.name: ACTION
attribute.description: This property defines the action to be invoked when an alarm is triggered. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified once in a "VALARM" calendar component.]

attribute.name: REPEAT
attribute.description: This property defines the number of times the alarm should be repeated, after the initial trigger. [Conformance: This property can be specified in a "VALARM" calendar component.]

attribute.name: TRIGGER
attribute.description: This property specifies when an alarm will trigger. [Conformance: This property MUST be specified in the "VALARM" calendar component.]

attribute.name: CREATED
attribute.description: [Conformance: The property can be specified once in "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar components. The value MUST be specified as a date with UTC time.]

attribute.name: DTSTAMP
attribute.description: In the case of an iCalendar object that specifies a "METHOD" property, this property specifies the date and time that the instance of the iCalendar object was created. In the case of an iCalendar object that doesn't specify a "METHOD" property, this property specifies the date and time that the information associated with the calendar component was last revised in the calendar store. [Conformance: This property MUST be included in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components.]

attribute.name: LAST-MODIFIED
attribute.description: [Conformance: This property can be specified in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VTIMEZONE" calendar components.]

attribute.name: SEQUENCE
attribute.description: This property defines the revision sequence number of the calendar component within a sequence of revisions. [Conformance: The property can be specified in "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar component.]

attribute.name: REQUEST-STATUS
attribute.description: This property defines the status code returned for a scheduling request. [Conformance: The property can be specified in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar component.]

attribute.name: ALTREP
attribute.description: To specify an alternate text representation for the property value.

attribute.name: CN
attribute.description: To specify the common name to be associated with the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: CUTYPE
attribute.description: To identify the type of calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: DELEGATED-FROM
attribute.description: To specify the calendar users that have delegated their participation to the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: DELEGATED-TO
attribute.description: To specify the calendar users to whom the calendar user specified by the property has delegated participation.

attribute.name: DIR
attribute.description: To specify reference to a directory entry associated with the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: ENCODING
attribute.description: To specify an alternate inline encoding for the property value.

attribute.name: FMTTYPE
attribute.description: To specify the content type of a referenced object.

attribute.name: FBTYPE
attribute.description: To specify the free or busy time type.

attribute.name: LANGUAGE
attribute.description: To specify the language for text values in a property or property parameter.

attribute.name: MEMBER
attribute.description: To specify the group or list membership of the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: PARTSTAT
attribute.description: To specify the participation status for the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: RELATED
attribute.description: To specify the relationship of the alarm trigger with respect to the start or end of the calendar component.

attribute.name: RELTYPE
attribute.description: To specify the type of hierarchical relationship associated with the calendar component specified by the property.

attribute.name: ROLE
attribute.description: To specify the participation role for the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: RSVP
attribute.description: To specify whether there is an expectation of a favor of a reply from the calendar user specified by the property value.

attribute.name: SENT-BY
attribute.description: To specify the calendar user that is acting on behalf of the calendar user specified by the property.

attribute.name: TZID
attribute.description: To specify the identifier for the time zone definition for a time component in the property value.

attribute.name: VALUE
attribute.description: To explicitly specify the value type format for a property value.

attribute.name: BOOLEAN
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain either a "TRUE" or "FALSE" Boolean value.

attribute.name: CAL-ADDRESS
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain a calendar user address.

attribute.name: DATE
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify values that contain a calendar date.

attribute.name: DATE-TIME
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify values that specify a precise calendar date and time of day.

attribute.name: DURATION
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain a duration of time.

attribute.name: FLOAT
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain a real-number value.

attribute.name: INTEGER
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain a signed integer value.

attribute.name: PERIOD
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify values that contain a precise period of time.

attribute.name: RECUR
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain a recurrence rule specification.

attribute.name: TEXT
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify values that contain human-readable text.

attribute.name: TIME
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify values that contain a time of day.

attribute.name: URI
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain an offset from UTC to local time.

attribute.name: UTC-OFFSET
attribute.description: This value type is used to identify properties that contain an offset from UTC to local time.
